studio.promptPlaceholder: Describe the picture: subject, setting, light, lens, mood…
studio.emptyBody: Write a prompt on the right and press Generate. Results appear here and in the strip below.

errors.network: Photo is not responding. Check that it is still running.
errors.clipboard: Your browser did not allow copying the image.

api.model_not_installed: This model is not downloaded yet. Install it on the Models page.
api.engine_not_installed: The engine is not installed. Run the installer again.
api.token_required: This device needs an access token to use Photo.
api.host_not_allowed: Open Photo using its own address.
api.origin_not_allowed: This request came from another website and was blocked.
api.references_unsupported: This model cannot follow reference pictures. Choose FLUX.2 Klein.
api.variation_unsupported: Variations need Z-Image Turbo. Download it on the Models page.
api.detail_unsupported: Extra detail is not available for this model.
api.input_not_found: One of the pictures no longer exists. Remove it and try again.
api.enhancer_unavailable: Download a model first: the prompt helper uses its language model.
api.invalid_image: This file is not a picture Photo can read.
api.engine_unavailable: The engine is starting. Try again in a moment.
api.engine_error: The engine could not finish this request.
api.edit_model_missing: Editing pictures needs FLUX.2 Klein. Download it on the Models page.
api.upscaler_missing: Enlarging needs Real-ESRGAN. Download it on the Models page.
api.already_large: This picture is already as large as it gets.

job.out_of_memory: Not enough video memory. Try a smaller size or fewer images, or close other programs that use the GPU.
job.engine_unavailable: The engine stopped and is restarting. Try again in a moment.
job.engine_not_installed: The engine is not installed. Run the installer again.
job.interrupted: Photo was closed while this image was being made.
job.engine_error: This image could not be generated.
job.empty_selection: Nothing is selected. Select an area and try again.

onboarding.title: Download a model to start
onboarding.body: Photo runs entirely on your computer. It needs one image model on disk before it can generate; the download is checked for integrity and resumes if interrupted.
onboarding.later: More models can be added later on the Models page.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.noFavorites: No favourites yet. Press F on an image to add it.
gallery.openInStudio: Open in Studio with these settings

models.title: Models
models.gpuLine: {{gpu}}, {{vram}} GB. Model versions are chosen for {{arch}} automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutBody: Photo {{version}}. Open source under the Apache 2.0 licence.
settings.privacy: Everything runs on this computer. Prompts and images never leave it, and Photo collects no telemetry.

modelInfo.z-image-turbo: Fast photorealistic images in 8 steps. Strong at people, products and legible text.
modelInfo.flux2-klein-4b: Follows reference pictures: matches a style, keeps a person or a product, combines up to four pictures. Also fast at plain text-to-image.

language.title: Choose your language
language.lead: Photo will use it everywhere. You can change it later in Settings.

system.title: Your computer
system.gpuUnsupported: Photo is built for NVIDIA RTX 40 and 50 series. This card may be slow or fail.
system.driverOld: Driver {{min}} or newer is required. Update it at nvidia.com/drivers, then run the installer again.
system.noGpuHelp: Photo needs an NVIDIA RTX graphics card with a current driver. Install the driver from nvidia.com/drivers, then run the installer again.

storage.title: Where to keep everything
storage.lead: Models and the engine are large. Put them on a fast drive with plenty of space; an SSD makes models load several times faster.

models_dir.title: Models
models_dir.body: AI models you download. Grows as you add models.

engine_env_dir.title: Engine
engine_env_dir.body: The image engine and its GPU libraries.

data_dir.title: Gallery
data_dir.body: Your images, their settings and the history.

models.title: Choose models
models.lead: Start with the recommended model. You can add others later on the Models page.

install.title: Ready to install
install.lead: Everything will be downloaded and checked. This usually takes 10–40 minutes, depending on your connection.
install.runningLead: You can keep using your computer. Downloads resume if the connection drops.
install.keepOpen: Keep this page and the installer window open.

errors.network: The installer is not responding. Check that its window is still open.
errors.unknown_model: One of the selected models is not available.
errors.path_not_absolute: Enter a full path, for example D:\Photo\models.
errors.path_system_folder: System folders cannot be used. Choose another folder.
errors.path_is_file: This path points to a file. Choose a folder.
errors.path_not_writable: Photo cannot write to this folder. Choose another one.
errors.download_failed: A download failed. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.disk_error: Could not write to the disk. Check that it is connected and has free space.
errors.engine_checksum: The engine download was damaged. Try again.
errors.engine_packages: Installing the GPU libraries failed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.cuda_unavailable: The engine cannot use your graphics card. Update the NVIDIA driver and try again.
errors.uv_missing: The installer is incomplete. Download Photo again.
errors.frontend_missing: The interface files are missing. Download the release package again.

looks.modeReferencesHint: The result follows the style, people or objects in up to four pictures
looks.modeVariationHint: Start from one picture and keep its composition and colours
looks.dropHint: Drop files here, paste with Ctrl+V or click to choose
looks.enhanceHint: A local language model adds light, lens and mood, and translates it to English
looks.detailHint: A second pass at a higher resolution; takes about twice as long
looks.improveHint: Rewrite the prompt with more visual detail so you can review it
looks.addedAsReference: Added to the pictures to follow
looks.qualityMaxHint: Best light, depth and detail. Slower: about 20–30 s per picture.

edit.compare: Hold to see the previous version

hint.brush: Paint over what you want to change. [ and ] change the brush size; hold Alt to erase.
hint.rect: Drag to select a rectangle. Hold Alt to remove from the selection.
hint.lasso: Click to place points, or drag to draw around. Double-click, Enter or the first point closes it.

edit.selected: Selected: {{share}} of the picture. Only this area will change.
edit.noSelectionWhole: Nothing selected: the whole picture will change. Select an area to change only that part.
edit.selectFirst: Select the area on the picture first.
edit.promptPlaceholder: For example: replace the book with a cup of coffee
edit.example3: Replace the background with a beach
edit.emptyBody: Open a photo from your computer, drop it here, paste it with Ctrl+V, or click a picture in the strip below.
